exact_confirmatory_cusum_implementation.trigger_event_rule: A trigger event occurs on day t when S_pos_t >= h during a baseline CASH day and hard risk-off is false.
exact_confirmatory_cusum_implementation.activation_permission_rule: CUSUM_UPSHIFT_ACTIVE turns on only if the upshift condition still holds on each of the next 2 consecutive days after the trigger event, so activation can first occur on trigger+2.
exact_confirmatory_cusum_implementation.confirmation_failure_rule: If either post-trigger confirmation day fails because S_pos_t < h, hard risk-off becomes true, or the baseline leaves CASH, the trigger candidate resets and the probe remains off.
exact_confirmatory_cusum_implementation.permission_clear_rule: After activation, CUSUM_UPSHIFT_ACTIVE clears when S_neg_t >= h, when hard BTC risk-off invalidation is true, or when the baseline is no longer in CASH.
exact_confirmatory_cusum_implementation.downstream_integration_rule: Baseline risk-on days remain unchanged. On baseline CASH days only, the probe replaces CASH with full BTC risk while CUSUM_UPSHIFT_ACTIVE is true.

why_same_family_not_duplicate: This remains the same family because BTC log returns, causal 63-day realized-vol standardization, two-sided Page CUSUM, fixed k = 0.25, fixed h = 5.0, baseline-cash-only integration, and the clear logic all stay unchanged; only activation turns on after a 2-day post-trigger hold confirmation.

exact_no_lookahead_design.return_transform: daily BTC log return r_t = log(close_t / close_{t-1})
exact_no_lookahead_design.vol_standardization: sigma_t is the causal 63-day rolling standard deviation of BTC daily log returns using only returns up to day t; x_t = r_t / sigma_t.
exact_no_lookahead_design.detector_update: The positive and negative CUSUM accumulators are updated sequentially one day at a time using only x_t and the previous accumulator state.
exact_no_lookahead_design.confirmation_timing: A trigger event is recorded on day t when S_pos_t >= h on a baseline CASH day and hard risk-off is false. Activation is allowed only if the upshift condition still holds on each of the next 2 consecutive days, so the earliest possible turn-on is day t+2 with no future data.
exact_no_lookahead_design.integration_reset: CUSUM permission is reset whenever the baseline is not in CASH. This keeps the probe earlier-activation-only and prevents any persistence carryover through baseline risk-on days.
exact_no_lookahead_design.fitting: No future-aware fitting, no return optimization, and no global calibration pass are used.

exact_single_heuristic_used_to_set_param.single_heuristic: Use the smallest non-sweep anti-noise hold above the immediate trigger: require exactly 2 consecutive post-trigger days with S_pos_t >= h before activation. k = 0.25 and h = 5.0 remain fixed from the base family.

cost_model.source_context: phase68i dynamic ladder export fee/slippage fields used only as secondary cost assumptions

stop_condition.rule: stop if confirmation kills most of the edge, or if switch/churn does not improve versus the prior CUSUM result, or if turnover worsens, or if the result collapses toward old-family behavior

pause_condition.rule: pause if churn improves but the evidence breadth is still too narrow for a stronger claim
